# API

## EconomyConfig

The value type holding all tuning values. Override only the fields you need from `EconomyConfig.Default`.

| Field                     | Default | Description                                                                        |
| ------------------------- | ------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `TickInterval`            | `1`     | Simulation time (seconds) for one long tick                                        |
| `PriceInertia`            | `0.15`  | Speed the long-term price converges to its target (0\~1). **Symmetric inertia**    |
| `DemandWeight`            | `1`     | Weight of the demand term in the price formula                                     |
| `ShortTermResponse`       | `0.5`   | How strongly a single trade pulls the short-term price (0\~1)                      |
| `ShortTermDecay`          | `0.25`  | How strongly the short-term price mean-reverts to the long-term price (0\~1)       |
| `InflationSensitivity`    | `0.1`   | Sensitivity of source/sink pressure on the inflation multiplier. 0 disables it     |
| `MinPriceMultiplier`      | `0.25`  | Lower bound of the final price multiplier                                          |
| `MaxPriceMultiplier`      | `4`     | Upper bound of the final price multiplier                                          |
| `InflationAlertThreshold` | `0.2`   | `OnInflationAlert` fires above this absolute pressure                              |
| `TradeFlowRate`           | `0.1`   | Fraction of stock moved from surplus→deficit nodes each tick (0\~1). 0 disables it |

## Economy

The single entry point (facade) of the dynamic economy.

### Construction

```csharp
Economy(EconomyConfig config, bool autoTick = false)
```

When `autoTick` is true, a hidden runner calls `Tick` every frame. Call `Dispose()` on shutdown.

### Registration

| Method                                                     | Description                                                       |
| ---------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `AddCommodity(id, basePrice, targetStock, baseDemand = 0)` | Register a commodity definition                                   |
| `AddMarket(id, initialStock = null)`                       | Register a market (node). Initial stock optional                  |
| `AddRecipe(marketId, inputs, outputs, throughput = 1)`     | Production/consumption recipe. Empty `outputs` = pure consumption |
| `AddTradeRoute(marketA, marketB)`                          | Connect two nodes with a trade route                              |

### Trading (inflation-neutral)

| Method                                  | Returns       | Description                                 |
| --------------------------------------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------- |
| `Buy(marketId, commodityId, quantity)`  | `TradeResult` | Player buys. Partial fill if stock is short |
| `Sell(marketId, commodityId, quantity)` | `TradeResult` | Player sells                                |

### source / sink (causes inflation)

| Method                                     | Description                                                     |
| ------------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `Inject(commodityId, amount, tag = null)`  | Goods created from nothing (faucet). `tag` is a telemetry label |
| `Consume(commodityId, amount, tag = null)` | Goods permanently removed (sink)                                |

### Queries

| Method                                | Returns | Description                                                       |
| ------------------------------------- | ------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `GetPrice(marketId, commodityId)`     | `float` | Current unit price (supply/demand + inflation multiplier applied) |
| `GetStock(marketId, commodityId)`     | `float` | Current stock                                                     |
| `GetInflationMultiplier(commodityId)` | `float` | Global inflation multiplier (1 = neutral, \<1 surplus, >1 scarce) |
| `GetSinkFaucetRatio(commodityId)`     | `float` | sink/faucet ratio. Above 1 means sink dominates                   |

### Tick

```csharp
void Tick(float deltaTime)
```

Each time accumulated time reaches `TickInterval`, runs a long tick (production → trade → price convergence → inflation update).

### Events

| Event              | Signature                       | When                           |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------ |
| `OnPriceChanged`   | `(market, commodity, newPrice)` | Unit price updated             |
| `OnStockChanged`   | `(market, commodity, newStock)` | Stock changed                  |
| `OnTradeExecuted`  | `(TradeResult)`                 | Trade settled                  |
| `OnInflationAlert` | `(commodity, pressure)`         | Pressure exceeds the threshold |
| `OnDailyTick`      | `()`                            | One long tick completed        |

## TradeResult

The result of `Buy`/`Sell`. On failure it returns with `Success == false` instead of throwing.

| Field                  | Type     | Description                              |
| ---------------------- | -------- | ---------------------------------------- |
| `Success`              | `bool`   | Whether it settled                       |
| `Market` / `Commodity` | `string` | Target node/commodity id                 |
| `Quantity`             | `float`  | Actual filled quantity                   |
| `UnitPrice`            | `float`  | Settled unit price                       |
| `TotalCost`            | `float`  | Total amount                             |
| `StockAfter`           | `float`  | Stock after the trade                    |
| `Reason`               | `string` | Failure reason (empty string on success) |

## Price formula

```text
balance multiplier = (targetStock + demand + 1) / (currentStock + demand + 1)
final price        = basePrice × clamp(shortMul × inflationMul, Min, Max)
```

- **Short multiplier**: moves to the balance value by `ShortTermResponse` on each trade
- **Long multiplier**: converges symmetrically to the balance value by `PriceInertia` each tick; short mean-reverts to long
- **Inflation multiplier**: updated by net source/sink pressure — net creation \< 1 (cheaper), net removal > 1 (pricier)

# Changelog

This file records notable changes to the project. The format follows [Keep a Changelog](https://keepachangelog.com/en/1.0.0/), and versioning follows [Semantic Versioning](https://semver.org/).

## \[1.0.0] - 2026-06-21

### Added

- `Economy` facade: pricing, trade, production, and inflation unified behind one entry point
- `EconomyConfig` struct: all tuning values externalized into a single value type
- Supply-demand price discovery — short/long split, symmetric inertia to block the arbitrage exploit
- Inter-node trade flow — trade-route-based stock equalization
- Production/consumption loop — recipes convert inputs into outputs
- source/sink inflation metering — `Inject`/`Consume`, inflation multiplier and alerts
- Optional auto-tick runner (`autoTick: true`)
- EditMode tests (price formula determinism, symmetric inertia, inflation pressure)
- Basic usage sample (`Samples~/Basic Usage`)

# Getting Started

## 1. Create the economy

The only types you touch are `EconomyConfig` (struct) and `Economy` (class).

```csharp
using AchEconomy;

// Override only what you need from the defaults.
var config = EconomyConfig.Default;
config.TickInterval = 2f;   // long tick every 2 seconds
config.PriceInertia = 0.2f;

var economy = new Economy(config);
```

## 2. Register commodities and markets

```csharp
economy.AddCommodity("wheat", basePrice: 10f, targetStock: 100f, baseDemand: 5f);
economy.AddCommodity("cloth", basePrice: 40f, targetStock: 30f);

economy.AddMarket("village", new() { ["wheat"] = 250f });
economy.AddMarket("town",    new() { ["wheat"] = 20f, ["cloth"] = 40f });
```

`basePrice` is the price when stock is balanced with `targetStock`. Below the target it gets more expensive; above it, cheaper.

## 3. Trading

A trade is a **movement of goods**, so it is inflation-neutral.

```csharp
var r = economy.Buy("town", "cloth", 5f);
// r.UnitPrice, r.TotalCost, r.StockAfter, r.Success

float price = economy.GetPrice("town", "cloth");  // slightly higher as stock dropped
```

:::info
If stock is insufficient, it **fills partially** instead of throwing. Check the actual filled amount with `r.Success` and `r.Quantity`.
:::

## 4. Production/consumption loop

A recipe turns input commodities into outputs each long tick. With empty outputs it acts as pure consumption (e.g. population eating food).

```csharp
// Town consumes 3 wheat to produce 1 cloth, 2 runs per tick
economy.AddRecipe("town",
    inputs:  new[] { ("wheat", 3f) },
    outputs: new[] { ("cloth", 1f) },
    throughput: 2f);
```

## 5. Inter-node trade

Stock equalizes between nodes connected by a trade route, flowing from surplus to deficit nodes — simulating AI caravan arbitrage.

```csharp
economy.AddTradeRoute("village", "town");
// Cut the route (don't connect) and prices diverge between nodes — intended causality
```

## 6. Inflation management (source / sink)

Just tell it when goods are **created from nothing** (faucet) or **permanently removed** (sink), and inflation correction happens automatically inside.

```csharp
economy.Inject("wheat", 100f, tag: "daily_quest"); // quest reward = faucet
economy.Consume("wheat", 30f, tag: "crafting");    // crafting cost = sink

// Subscribe only if you care (safe to ignore)
economy.OnInflationAlert += (commodity, pressure) =>
    Debug.Log($"{commodity} inflation pressure {pressure:P0}");
```

## 7. Advancing time

```csharp
void Update() => economy.Tick(Time.deltaTime);
```

:::warning
If you need determinism in multiplayer (lockstep / Quantum, etc.), use **manual `Tick` + equation-based** simulation. `Tick` produces the same result for the same input.
:::

If auto-tick is more convenient, `new Economy(config, autoTick: true)` makes a hidden runner call `Tick` every frame. In that case, call `economy.Dispose()` on shutdown to clean it up.

See the [API reference](/ach-economy/en/api.md) for the full surface.

# Introduction

## What is Ach Economy?

**Ach Economy** packages a living economy — where shop prices and stock are not fixed values but shift with production, consumption, and player trading — into a reusable Unity package.

Pass a single `EconomyConfig` and the `Economy` class runs **pricing, inter-node trade, production/consumption, and inflation tracking** entirely on its own. No ScriptableObjects, no components to attach to a scene.

```csharp
var economy = new Economy(EconomyConfig.Default);
economy.AddCommodity("wheat", basePrice: 10f, targetStock: 100f);
economy.AddMarket("town_a", new() { ["wheat"] = 200f });

var r = economy.Buy("town_a", "wheat", 10);   // stock ↓ → price ↑
```

## Two layers

A dynamic economy splits into two layers of different character. Treating them as one tangles the design.

### [Micro — price discovery](/ach-economy/en/getting-started.md)

Price and stock move from a single market's supply/demand. The core of trade and shop content.

### [Macro — inflation](/ach-economy/en/api.md)

How much currency/goods enter (source) and leave (sink) the whole economy. The core of live service.

Ach Economy hides both behind a single `Economy` facade, exposing only two things to you: the **`EconomyConfig` struct and the `Economy` class**.

## Key features

| Feature                         | Description                                                                             |
| ------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| **Short/long price split**      | Short-term price reacts per trade; long-term converges each tick with symmetric inertia |
| **Symmetric inertia**           | Same speed up and down → blocks the "dump then buy next day" arbitrage exploit          |
| **Inter-node trade**            | Stock equalizes between nodes linked by trade routes (automatic arbitrage simulation)   |
| **Production/consumption loop** | Recipes turn inputs into outputs, feeding the supply/demand numbers                     |
| **source/sink metering**        | `Inject`/`Consume` record faucet/drain to derive inflation pressure                     |

## Installation

In the Unity Package Manager, choose **Add package from git URL...** and enter the address below.

```text
https://github.com/achieveonepark/ach-economy.git
```

:::info
To pin a specific version, push a release tag and append it like `...ach-economy.git#1.0.0`. OpenUPM registration is not yet available.
:::

Next, head to [Getting Started](/ach-economy/en/getting-started.md) to build your first economy.
